description: Assemble error message skeletons. Give `problem` (what happened, required), and optionally `cause`, `fix` (the next step), `where` (field or page), `severity` (blocking, recoverable, warning), `dataSaved` (yes if the user's work is safe), `canRetry` and `contact`. Returns three layouts (inline under a field, banner or toast, full-page with title, body and buttons) built from your wording with square-bracket placeholders where you gave nothing, plus flags: blame words (invalid, wrong, you failed), technical codes, cute openers, missing next step, fix not starting with a verb, length limits, missing way to reach a person on blocking errors. It does not write the copy for you.

canRetry.description: yes if trying again can work

cause.description: Why, only if the reader can use it

dataSaved.description: yes if the user's work is safe

fix.description: What the reader can do next

name: error_state_writer_template
title: Error state skeleton
